info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Chervil Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API enables the management of chervil produce details within the catalog system. By utilizing this endpoint, authorized users can create and input detailed information about chervil products, facilitating better inventory management and product offerings. Typical consumers of this API include inventory managers and e-commerce platforms seeking to enhance their product listings. It ensures accurate representation and easy access to important product specifications and attributes.

post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of detailed information for chervil produce, enabling better tracking and management of chervil inventory. It accepts all relevant details necessary for the chervil produce entry.
